title_en: DARK — EUCLID & ROMAN: MAPPING DARK MATTER AND DARK ENERGY
title_ru: ТЬМА — EUCLID И ROMAN: КАРТЫ ТЁМНОЙ МАТЕРИИ И ТЁМНОЙ ЭНЕРГИИ
description: An interactive field guide to the dark universe: Zwicky's 1933 cluster, Vera Rubin's flat rotation curves and a real fit to galaxy NGC 3198, the 1998 supernovae that showed the expansion speeding up, why weak lensing needs a billion galaxies, ESA's Euclid (launched July 2023) and NASA's Roman (launched 30 August 2026), and what DESI's hints of changing dark energy do and do not show.
og: A real dark-matter fit to galaxy NGC 3198, the accelerating universe in a supernova calculator, and why Euclid and Roman measure the shapes of a billion galaxies: dark matter and dark energy, interactive and sourced from ESA, NASA and the discovery papers.
